purpose: Guarantee durable evidence of each natural scheduler invocation before optional research/audit work consumes the short automation execution window.

root_cause_basis.observed_failure_pattern: Runs often triggered but failed to persist when control-plane reads, optional research, or broad repository queries consumed the execution window before the authoritative update.

steps: Fetch only <lane>/latest.json and retain its blob SHA as PREVIOUS_BLOB_SHA.
Immediately update <lane>/latest.json once with a fresh RUN_ID and liveness receipt.
Retain returned content_sha as PHASE1_BLOB_SHA; do not read back.
phase1_liveness.commit_message_requirement: End phase-1 commit message with [skip ci] to avoid spending CI on the intermediate liveness state.

steps: After phase-1 is durable, perform at most one bounded lane-specific work call.
If work returns in time, update latest.json once using PHASE1_BLOB_SHA and the SAME RUN_ID.
Set FINALIZATION_STATUS=VERIFIED and WORK_PHASE_STATUS=COMPLETED or DEGRADED_COMPLETED.
Record truthful NET_NEW_DELTA, DATA_GAPS, CONFLICTS and completed_at_utc.
If work stalls or fails, do not retry; phase-1 liveness remains the durable outcome.

optimistic_concurrency.rule: Never retry inside the same natural execution. Next scheduled invocation starts from fresh state.

scheduler_jitter.rule: Use nominal slot in scheduled_for. Jitter within tolerance is transport timing, not a persistence failure.

acceptance.liveness_single_run: One natural phase-1 receipt stored successfully with exact identity and required values.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural v4.2 liveness receipts with distinct RUN_IDs and distinct persisted blob SHAs.
acceptance.work_completion: Track the fraction of v4.2 liveness runs that also reach phase-2 VERIFIED/COMPLETED or DEGRADED_COMPLETED.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five active lanes satisfy sustained_lane while scheduler registry remains exactly five enabled authoritative lanes.

legacy_artifacts.v3: heartbeat.json, checkpoint.json, core/, history/, finalization/ are read-only historical evidence.
legacy_artifacts.v4_0_v4_1: Existing receipts remain historical evidence but do not count toward v4.2 acceptance.
